description: This PHP class defines the 'Module' model within the OpenCart administration system, providing CRUD operations for managing modules in the database. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and fetching module records, adhering to OpenCart's MVC architecture.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Model class for managing modules in the database, including methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve module data.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Creates a new module record in the database with specified code and data, returning the new module's ID.

methods.name: editModule
methods.description: Updates the database record of a module identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a module record from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes all modules with a specific code and related layout modules.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the module data for a specific module ID, decoding JSON settings.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches all module records from the database.

methods.name: getModulesByCode
methods.description: Retrieves all modules with a specific code.
